objective: Establish a leakage-safe, evidence-backed method to assess and improve the daily report's forecast precision without claiming predictive edge prematurely.

checks.description: Audit frozen source reports and ledger rows for mature outcomes, horizons, source comparability, missingness and leakage constraints.
evidence: PRSG-81 experiment report: evaluator at 2026-10-09T18:34:00+08:00; 120 total, 0 scored, 95 pending and 25 mature but unscored; actual-close and availability fields are blank.

Tracked artifact inventory: no raw Yahoo response body verifies the 95 US references. 57 Sep 30 report snapshots match values but lack venue/adjustment basis; 7 Sep 30 references do not match the report; 30 Oct 8 report rows carry daily-bar metadata but not row-level price-field/basis; 1 Oct 9 SPY row records Yahoo adjclose but lacks raw body and venue proof. Trader review: zero rows currently approved for strict close-to-close scoring; possible cohorts require separately verified snapshot-to-close or identical adjusted-close basis. No actuals fetched or ledger values changed.

evidence: PRSG-81 experiment report: fixed 20-session inputs, 2/3-session non-overlapping chronological origins, zero-return, drift and prior-sign baselines, point MAE/RMSE, direction, coverage, interval score and block-bootstrap uncertainty; no market-wide threshold is defensible from one SPY series.

checks.description: Registered Trader reviews interpretability and limitations of Moomoo directional inputs for the proposed forecast comparison.
evidence: Registered Trader read-only review: preserve separate 2/3-session cohorts, point-in-time close/adjustment provenance, matched rows, zero-return/prior-sign baselines, separate direction/interval metrics and time-clustered uncertainty; current ledger cannot score the Oct 9 target cohort.

Follow-up source comparability review: 57 Sep 30 matched intraday snapshots are only a possible separately labeled snapshot-to-target-close cohort after quote-field/venue/basis checks; 30 Oct 8 rows need confirmation that frozen reference_close is the report's adjusted daily-close field; 1 Oct 9 SPY adjclose row still needs matching target basis and verified session/source timestamps; seven unmatched Sep 30 rows remain blocked. Zero rows approved for strict close-to-close scoring from tracked evidence. No retrieval or writes authorized.

evidence: Lead decision in PRSG-81 experiment report: keep both methods research-only; collect verified outcomes and compare across US tickers and Bursa separately; no production integration.

Follow-up experiment B extends the research-only comparison across the fixed 30-name U.S. cohort; results still do not justify production integration.

Follow-up experiment C runs pinned TimesFM 2.5 and Chronos-2 on the same 30-name U.S. adjusted-close snapshot and matched 2/3-session origins. TimesFM-minus-zero MAE was +0.218/+0.300 log-return percentage points; 80% interval coverage was 69.3%/65.6%. No model promotion; full training cutoff and point-in-time data remain unverified.

Lead's follow-on recommendation, based on Engineer's schema design and Trader's financial review: preserve v1 history; use a separate forward-only v2 ledger; require instrument/listing, source and observation semantics, price field and corporate-action vintage, source/retrieval/observation timestamps, exact target-session calendar and horizon convention, and an explicit human evidence-eligibility decision before scoring. Provider/calendar/registry/storage dependencies must be frozen before implementation; unresolved evidence remains pending/excluded.
Lead reviewed the experiment report against all four checklist items. No production files, report outputs, ledger rows or unrelated working-tree edits were changed.

Lead independently reviewed the 30-name experiment protocol, matched horizon metrics, per-date clustered bootstrap, directional denominators, model cutoff caveat, and report-selected universe limitations. Only the ticket report and manifest changed; pre-existing ingest/daily_report_projection.py edit was preserved.

Trader reviewed the multi-ticker findings: ticker-date rows are dependent, five-date blocks may miss longer serial/regime dependence, q10-q90 coverage alone does not establish calibration, and retrospective adjusted-close/model-training-cutoff uncertainty prevents a clean out-of-sample or significance claim.

Follow-up dependence sensitivity: five-, ten-, and twenty-target-date blocks plus crossed ticker-by-ten-date-block bootstrap (10,000 resamples); all Chronos-minus-zero MAE intervals remained positive. Trader cautions remain recorded; interpretation is conditional on sample/design.

Follow-up experiment C: TimesFM 2.5 source and weight revisions pinned; same-snapshot, same-origin paired comparison with Chronos-2. Local output review verified unique matched rows and finite, positive, ordered TimesFM q10/q50/q90. Trader recommended no further candidate search before point-in-time outcome collection; Engineer found no clear origin/horizon or TimesFM quantile-index error and flagged the retrospective-vintage/model-cutoff and inference limits. Five/ten/twenty-date and crossed ticker-date sensitivity intervals for TimesFM-minus-zero MAE remained positive; direct TimesFM-versus-Chronos intervals include zero in H3 and crossed sensitivity.

Trader's read-only row-level audit of the 25 MY ledger rows found all actual/source/availability/outcome fields blank, generic week_end horizons and missing reference time/adjustment-vintage details. Evaluator classifies them mature-but-not-scored from expected close time only; Bursa date/security eligibility remains unverified. No actuals were fetched or ledger rows changed.

Engineer read-only inventory found no raw Yahoo response body exactly verifying any of the 95 US references. It matched 57 Sep 30 watchlist rows to intraday USD report snapshots, found seven unmatched Sep 30 weekly rows, 30 Oct 8 adjusted-daily-bar report records without row-level selected field/basis, and one Oct 9 SPY report row with explicit adjclose basis but no raw body/venue evidence. Trader's follow-up determined zero rows currently pass strict close-to-close eligibility; the 57 snapshot rows would require a separate snapshot-to-close definition and same-basis target. No prices or ledger writes.

Engineer delivered a read-only forward-only schema/evaluator proposal; Trader reviewed it and required controlled instrument identity (including share class/ADR where relevant), source class separate from observation kind, explicit provider field/session meaning and adjustment vintage, distinct source-available/retrieved/observed times, exact target session/horizon convention, calendar and instrument mapping versions, range units, immutable evidence references, and explicit review-based eligibility. Lead recommends a separate v2 ledger rather than rewriting historical v1 rows; provider, calendar, and approved evidence-storage dependencies remain to be frozen before any implementation.
